description: Independently authored certification corpus. Expected verdicts determined by human reasoning, NOT by observing verifier behavior. Contains positive (must admit), negative (must block), and metamorphic (one-dimension mutation, must block) cases.

corpus_provenance.independent_basis: Each expected verdict was determined by direct human analysis of whether the evidence JSON logically entails the claim proposition. No verifier output was consulted.
corpus_provenance.positive_cases: Valid claims where evidence directly contains the claimed (subject, predicate, value) triple. These MUST be admitted — a firewall that rejects everything is not correct.
corpus_provenance.negative_cases: Invalid claims where evidence contradicts or doesn't contain the claim. These MUST be blocked.
corpus_provenance.metamorphic_cases: One-dimension mutations of valid claims. Each changes exactly one proposition dimension (subject, value, version, condition). These MUST be blocked — the verifier must detect single-dimension semantic changes.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that M3_REFINED retrieval reliability is 96.97.
cases.expected_reason: Evidence JSON contains M3_REFINED.retrieval_reliability = 96.97 with condition=6_month_benchtop. Subject, predicate, value, condition, and version all match. No comparator declared (wildcard).
cases.independent_basis: Direct JSON key-value match: the evidence contains the exact (subject, predicate, value) triple the claim asserts. No interpretation needed — it's a direct lookup.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that M3_REFINED self_test_detection is 60.0.
cases.expected_reason: Evidence contains M3_REFINED.self_test_detection = 60.0, matching the claim.
cases.independent_basis: Direct key-value match in evidence JSON.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that A4_cryo_debonding retrieval reliability is 88.86 under mean.
cases.expected_reason: Evidence contains A4_cryo_debonding.retrieval_reliability = 88.86. Subject, predicate, value, and version match.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that A4_cryo_debonding retrieval reliability is 96.97.
cases.expected_reason: Evidence assigns 96.97 to M3_REFINED, not A4_cryo_debonding. A4's value is 88.86. The claim assigns the wrong value to the wrong entity.
cases.independent_basis: Read the evidence JSON: M3_REFINED.retrieval_reliability=96.97, A4_cryo_debonding.retrieval_reliability=88.86. The claim says A4=96.97, which is false.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that M3_REFINED retrieval reliability is 96.97 per V3.
cases.expected_reason: Evidence is from V6, but claim says V3. Version mismatch.
cases.independent_basis: The evidence JSON has version=V6. The claim declares version=V3. These don't match.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that M3_REFINED retrieval reliability is 96.97 mmHg.
cases.expected_reason: Evidence value is 96.97 (unitless/percentage), claim says 96.97 mmHg. Unit mismatch.
cases.independent_basis: The evidence has retrieval_reliability=96.97 (a percentage metric). mmHg is a pressure unit, not applicable to reliability. Units don't match.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that M3_REFINED retrieval reliability is 96.97 under all_conditions.
cases.expected_reason: Evidence condition is 'mean' (average), but claim says 'all_conditions'. Average ≠ all conditions — claiming all conditions when evidence only shows average is an overclaim.
cases.independent_basis: The evidence reports the MEAN reliability. 'all_conditions' would require the value to hold in EVERY condition, including worst-case. The worst-case is 30%, so claiming 'all_conditions' at 96.97% is false.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that M3_REFINED retrieval reliability is 99.99.
cases.expected_reason: Evidence says 96.97, claim says 99.99. Value not found in evidence.
cases.independent_basis: The evidence has retrieval_reliability=96.97. The claim says 99.99. 99.99 is not in the evidence.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that A4_cryo_debonding retrieval reliability is 96.97.
cases.expected_reason: Metamorphic mutation: subject changed from M3_REFINED to A4_cryo_debonding. Evidence only has M3_REFINED.
cases.independent_basis: Mutation of POS-001: changed subject M3→A4. Evidence doesn't contain A4_cryo_debonding data.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that M3_REFINED retrieval reliability is 96.98.
cases.expected_reason: Metamorphic mutation: value changed from 96.97 to 96.98. One-bit change in value.
cases.independent_basis: Mutation of POS-001: changed value 96.97→96.98. Evidence says 96.97, not 96.98.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that M3_REFINED retrieval reliability is 96.97 per V5.
cases.expected_reason: Metamorphic mutation: version changed from V6 to V5.
cases.independent_basis: Mutation of POS-001: changed version V6→V5. Evidence is V6.

cases.claim_text: The simulation estimated that M3_REFINED retrieval reliability is 96.97 under 12_month.
cases.expected_reason: Metamorphic mutation: condition changed from 6_month_benchtop to 12_month.
cases.independent_basis: Mutation of POS-001: changed condition 6_month→12_month. Evidence tests at 6 months, not 12.
